notes.title: Massive Update — Many Improvements
notes.content:
After many weeks of development, we've published a grand update to [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/i]. The main improvements are:

[list]
[*] A Spanish translation has been added.
[*] We made huge improvements to the Japanese and Chinese translation of the game.
[*] We improved lots of background art in Rika's ending.
[*] We replaced the majority of AI art placeholders that remained in the game.
[/list]

Now, let us drink,

Cheers, lain

leaves

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
This update includes several GUI improvements and completes a period of cumulative textual changes to the game script and the Russian translation.

Thank you for playing our game!

Cheers, lain
Leaves

notes.title: Small bugfixes
notes.content: Some small bugfixes to the game, plus some larger improvements to the Russian translation.

notes.title: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead is Releasing Now!
notes.content:
Deluge: Sermon for the Dead is leaving early access right now.

We'd like to thank everyone who has provided us with feedback, and all players past and present,

I hope you enjoy the game!

Cheers,

lain
Leaves

notes.title: Achievements and Bad Endings Added
notes.content:
We have just published the following changes to [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/i]:

[list]
[*] 13 Achievements have been implemented.
[*] 5 bad endings have been added.
[*] A number of placeholder artworks have been replaced.
[*] We did an extensive script workthrough, improving countless scenes.
[/list] 

This is a last update before the full release of the game that will take place later this month.

Please let us know if you experience any issues with the current build of the game.

Cheers,
lain

notes.title: Major Update Released!
notes.content:
We're just done releasing the second major update to [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b]. 

This update includes all ending routes and the 3 main good endings to the game, making it about 98% complete content wise. Only the bad endings are missing.

We will need about 4 to 8 weeks to finalize the game. This includes:
- adding all five bad endings
- improving and replacing placeholder artwork
- full script workthrough
- rewrite of select scenes
- general polishing and improvement

The current plan is to have the full release out in May (or June) 2024.

Thank you for all your feedback and for playing our games!

Cheers,
lain

leaves

notes.title: Game Update Coming This Week!
notes.content:
We'd like to thank you all for your patience. Even though we ran into a few delays, we've currently finished the last updates and bugfixes to the coming update of [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b]. All we need to do now is some functional playtests, which will take a few days, after that we should be able to release the game.

Thank you again for your patience,

Cheers,

lain,
leaves

notes.title: Game Update coming in February!
notes.content:
Just a short update announcing that the next update is currently coming along well. It should be released this month (February). Early March at the latest.

This update will contain virtually all game content (95%+), including all good endings. After this update, we will take some time to further complete and polish the game so that we can release a full version.

Thanks for your patience and continuous feedback,

Cheers, lain
Leaves

notes.title: Big Update to Early Access Version!
notes.content:
We'd like to announce a huge update to the early access version of [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead![/i]

This update finalizes the base section of the game, and adds the majority of the Marisa/Ina ending route. With this update, the game is about 70% done.

I'd like to thank you all for your patience. This update was long overdue. We hope to publish our next update early January 2024, bringing the game to about 95% completion.

Cheers,
lain

leaves

notes.title: Large update coming soon!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. We'll be publishing a big update to [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b] somewhere around Halloween.

As you may have noticed, the game has become delayed. This is mainly due to the size of the project. When we set out developing, we assumed this would be a 6-8 hour game — but now that we have fully worked out the different routes and plotlines, it will likely be closer to 10-15 hours. As we don't want to rush this game, we've decided to push forward our deadline to early 2024.

We'll be adding about 4 hours of gameplay soon, please stay posted,

Cheers,

lain
Leaves

notes.title: Update to script and translation files
notes.content: Fixed some errors in script and translation files.

notes.title: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead is out in Early Access
notes.content:
Our visual novel project [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/i] is currently releasing in early access.

Over the last months we have been working hard to bring this game to a presentable form. We’d love to hear your thoughts on the game. Please consider sending us your feedback via the Steam community hub, or by leaving a review. 

Currently it is late, I will update you further as soon as possible,

Cheers, lain

notes.title: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead store page is live!
notes.content:
We are excited to present the store page for our new visual novel project [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b]. Born from the myriad unused ideas and plotlines that we developed during the creation of our previous game — [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1745690/Deluge_Threnody_of_Crashing_Waves/]Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves[/url] — this game explores and expands new themes related to the town of Abbotsford and the brooding mysteries that surround it.

Sermon for the Dead will be an atmospheric mystery VN filled with political intrigue and lovecraftian horror. We are currently working towards an Early Access release, which is planned to appear somewhere next year. 

Stay posted,
lain

Leaves
